QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: noiseFilterEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Enable or disable real-time noise suppression.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Filters background environmental noise (wind, propeller buzz) from incoming microphone audio.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Noise Suppression

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: noiseFilterLevel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Controls the aggressiveness of background noise filtering on incoming microphone audio.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Suppression Level

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: maxRecordingDuration
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum recording duration for voice commands before automatic stop.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Limits voice command recording duration to prevent runaway audio capture. Automatically stops recording when reached.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Max Recording Duration

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: pushToTalkKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Keyboard shortcut key for Push-to-Talk voice commanding.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Physical keyboard key held down to record voice commands.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: PTT Shortcut Key
